name: webedge
description: WebEdge Solution — API and portal, deployable as one application.

scripts.//: These exist so the whole system deploys as ONE application. backend/ and frontend/ remain independently runnable; see DEPLOY.md for running them as two.
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm ci && cd ../frontend && npm ci
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
